title.fa: از صفویه تا قاجار: دین، دولت و روحانیت
title.en: From the Safavids to the Qajars: religion, state and clergy
title.nl: From the Safavids to the Qajars: religion, state and clergy

summary.fa: سه سده‌ای که ایران شیعه شد و روحانیتِ شیعه از کارگزارِ دولت به قدرتی مستقل با پول، پیرو و سلسله‌مراتبِ خودش بدل شد؛ زمینهٔ مشروطه و ۱۳۵۷.
summary.en: Three centuries in which Iran became Shia and the Shia clergy turned from state servants into an independent power with its own money, followers and hierarchy; the background to 1906 and 1979.
summary.nl: Three centuries in which Iran became Shia and the Shia clergy turned from state servants into an independent power with its own money, followers and hierarchy; the background to 1906 and 1979.
